title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 12 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for IAF Agniveer Vayu (Science + Other than Science combined pattern). 100 Questions | 85 Minutes | English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Time: 85 minutes (official combined Science + Other than Science pattern).
Physics and Mathematics 10+2 CBSE level; English 10+2; RAGA includes Reasoning and GK/Defence.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement.
options: Neither of the pilots were ready for the sortie.
Neither of the pilots was ready for the sortie.
Neither of the pilots are ready for the sortie.
Neither of the pilots have been ready for the sortie.
questions.explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb: was.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change into passive: The IAF will commission the new squadron next month.
options: The new squadron will be commissioned by the IAF next month.
The new squadron will commission by the IAF next month.
The new squadron is commissioned by the IAF next month.
The new squadron would have been commissioned next month.
questions.explanation: Future simple active → will be + past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, "I have already filed the flight plan."
options: He said that he had already filed the flight plan.
He said that he has already filed the flight plan.
He said that I had already filed the flight plan.
He told that he already filed the flight plan.
questions.explanation: Present perfect in direct speech becomes past perfect in indirect.
